parameters.name: EventId
parameters.description: The ID of the system Event.

parameters.name: OpsType
parameters.description:
The type of the operation. Valid values:

- immediate: Executes the operation immediately.

- scheduled: Executes the operation at the specified time.

parameters.name: PlanTime
parameters.description: The scheduled execution time, as a Timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is required when OpsType is set to scheduled.
